items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: That is another... Another wonderful musician. Another wonderful pianist. Trying to think what band he was with when I came to town.

ctx.x: Wonderful piano sport. You were mentioning, once again, just to improve my own knowledge in geography, you were mentioning not wanting to play in the district they call the Tenderloin. Now, is that Storyville or would that have been a different place at that time? Basin Street and all of them.
No, there's another piano stair that followed him, that Frank Cuehn. Uh-huh.
